evidence.description: The method 'fetchAndUpdate' uses 'URLSession.shared' as a default parameter value, which is a direct access to a global singleton service.

candidates.explanation: The code directly accesses the 'URLSession.shared' singleton as a default parameter for the 'urlSession' argument, creating a hard-coded dependency on a global service instead of requiring it to be supplied through an explicit dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access
